text:
Charlie: Heads-up: customer in eu-west-1 started seeing a sudden spike of 5xx + streaming 504s after they ramped concurrent streams. They reported ~100-140 concurrent streaming connections while also calling embeddings. Errors: a lot of HTTP/2 503 from the edge, intermittent 504s while reading stream frames, and SDK retry storms. They described the message: 'Upstream timed out (gateway)'.

Maya: Thanks. Can you share SDK version, exact model names, and a short repro? Also want to know if they use NATed IPs or many clients behind a single IP. :thinking:

Charlie: SDK: js 2.4.1. Models: rwd-open-7b (streaming chat) + rwd-embed-2 (embeddings). Repro (node pseudo):
```js
// open N streaming sessions then call embeddings
for (let i = 0; i < 120; i++) {
  client.chat.stream({ model: 'rwd-open-7b', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'hello' }] })
}
client.embeddings.create({ model: 'rwd-embed-2', input: ['x'] })
```
They said they see a bunch of 503s from edge and then some streams reset with 'RST_STREAM'. No config change on their side.

Raj: I'm pulling edge metrics for eu-west-1. I see a sharp rise in H2 stream counts and connection queue length around 17:10 UTC coincident with their ramp. Proxy logs show increased 503 responses and RST_STREAMs. There are also a handful of client IPs opening >100 sockets.

Elin: From runtime perspective, mixing streaming + embed RPCs can contend for the same model workers and trigger our soft concurrency safeguards. We intentionally return 503s for excess streams instead of queuing to protect latency SLOs. Also KV cache locks could be aggravated when embeddings and generation hit the same partition.

Maya: Short-term mitigations: ask customer to reduce concurrent streaming clients (suggested safe target 40-60), enable exponential backoff in their SDK, and avoid tight retry loops. Ops can apply a temporary whitelist exemption for the tenant to avoid per-IP ingress limits while we investigate.

Charlie: Customer already retries aggressively which creates a feedback loop. They can throttle client-side if we provide a recommended concurrency cap and a short window for testing.

Raj: I'll open an exemption to relax per-IP connection limiting for tenant acme-corp in eu-west-1 for 30 minutes. Also checking keepalive and listener backlog metrics; will escalate to infra if kernel listen backlog is saturated.

support-bot: Incident ticket INC-2038-552 opened. Routing: SRE + Runtime. Pager duty paged: Raj oncall.

Elin: I can push a runtime config to prioritize streaming RPCs for that tenant and bump soft concurrency from 48 -> 64 for the tenant namespace. I can apply via control plane config patch without a full rollout. ETA ~20-30m.

Raj: Whitelist applied. After Elin's priority patch and soft limit bump we see the 503 spike subside within ~5m; remaining 504s are only for a few long-lived streams that were mid-flight. Trend is downward.

Maya: Can we capture a few representative request IDs + sanitized headers from failing sessions for the postmortem? We'll need :method, :authority, user-agent, te, and auth redacted.

Charlie: Customer consented. Representative request IDs: rq_3f9a1c, rq_3f9a1d, rq_3f9a1e. Sanitized headers for rq_3f9a1d:
```:method: POST
:scheme: https
:authority: api.redwood.ai
authorization: Bearer <redacted>
user-agent: acme-streamer/1.2.0
te: trailers
content-length: 412
```

Raj: Those map to entries in the proxy logs. For rq_3f9a1d I see RST_STREAM code=8 and upstream 503 from the worker returned shortly before the reset. We'll capture trace IDs and include them in the postmortem.

Maya: Action checklist:
- [x] temporary per-IP whitelist applied for tenant
- [x] runtime priority + soft limit bump applied for tenant
- [ ] collect headers, request IDs, and traces (Charlie)
- [ ] provide customer guidance on safe concurrency and SDK backoff
- [ ] follow-up postmortem to decide long-term fixes (admission control, graceful backpressure, better routing of embeddings)

Charlie: Customer reports immediate improvement after throttling to ~50 concurrent streams. They'll run a controlled ramp and report stability.

Raj: We'll monitor eu-west edge metrics for 4 hours and schedule a postmortem if elevated error rate persists. Saving traces and linking to INC-2038-552. :thumbsup:

Maya: Thanks everyone. Charlie, please send the customer a short note: we applied temporary mitigations, recommend capping streams to 40-60 while we investigate, and we'll follow up with a root cause + timeline within 24 hours.

Charlie: Sent. Customer acknowledged. Closing support ticket after a confirmation window if metrics remain stable.
